parts: When hosting an Rmd file on a shiny server, do we have to use `runtime: shiny` in the YAML?  I noticed that when I don't add that, the first time I load a document it renders fine but any page refresh renders weird.  I'm not sure if it's something about my setup, or if documents on shiny server have to use that option
